description:
Rebuild the directory's `city_stats` MATERIALIZED VIEW — the per-(category, city)
rollup that the category hub and every city page read to know which cities exist
and how many listings each holds.

🔴 IT DOES NOT REFRESH A CATEGORY'S `listing_count`. Those are two different
numbers with similar names. `listing_count` lives on the category row and is
maintained by the WRITE paths (bulk upsert, import, prune, delete-listing);
nothing recomputes it on demand, and this tool will not. If a category's
listing_count looks wrong, re-run the write that produced it — calling this
changes nothing about it.

You rarely need this: every write path already refreshes city_stats itself. Reach
for it when a city page or hub is showing a stale city list after a change made
outside the normal write path.

Tenant-scoped. Returns the refresh result.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: directory_refresh_stats
